title.en: Continuous-time linear equalizer (CTLE): source RC-degenerated differential pair
title.zh: 连续时间线性均衡器（源极 RC 退化差分对）

description.en: A continuous-time linear equalizer: an NMOS differential pair whose sources are joined by an RC bridge that adds a high-frequency peaking zero. Schematic generated by the RNL solver.
description.zh: 连续时间线性均衡器：NMOS 差分对的两个源极之间接 RC 桥，引入高频峰化零点。原理图由 RNL 求解器生成。
